notes: Every message the tests build (COMMANDS, EVENTS, test_wire_shape_of_contract_examples) was copied by hand into a throwaway script and serialized with Message.encode() from protocol.py at d4ffb9d, so the byte form is the daemon's own (ensure_ascii=False, Python separators). Raw byte literals from the tests are copied verbatim. Duplicate lines are kept once. invalid.jsonl holds each line the tests reject, with the str() of the ProtocolError that decode_command or decode_event raised for it; lines rejected through Message.decode are listed once per side. The JSON parse message carries Python's json error text, which a JavaScript decoder does not reproduce.
